story.chapters.title:
IT ALL STARTS
IN THE FIELD.
story.chapters.description: Drilling, excavating, loading. Different machines, one same cycle. The operation needs rhythm — and visibility.
story.chapters.fact: MINEFY CONNECTS THE SIGNALS OF THOSE WHO PRODUCE.
story.chapters.label: EXCAVATION → LOADING
story.chapters.name: THE CYCLE BEGINS
story.chapters.sceneAria: Cinematic mining scene: excavation and loading

story.chapters.title:
THE MATERIAL
MOVES ON.
SO DOES THE DATA.
story.chapters.description: The material reaches the plant and goes through processing stages. Connecting information across fronts helps to see the flow, the rhythms and the interfaces of the operation.
story.chapters.fact: CONCEPTUAL REPRESENTATION OF THE MINERAL CYCLE.
story.chapters.label: HAULAGE → PROCESSING
story.chapters.name: THE OPERATION MOVES ON

story.chapters.title:
THE JOURNEY
CONTINUES
BEYOND THE PLANT.
story.chapters.description: In the tailings area, the amphibious Scroller works with helicoidal propulsion. Specialized operations also open room for visibility and monitoring.
story.chapters.label: TAILINGS → SCROLLER
story.chapters.name: NEW TERRAINS

story.chapters.title:
ON THE OUTSIDE,
THE POWER.
ON THE INSIDE, SIGNALS.
story.chapters.description: We follow TR-001 in motion. Every cycle leaves information that can help the operation understand the machine's behavior.
story.chapters.fact: KEEP SCROLLING TO ENTER THE MACHINE.
story.chapters.label: TR-001 → APPROACHING THE ENGINE
story.chapters.name: ONE MACHINE. ONE STORY.

story.chapters.title:
THE OIL
HEATS UP.
THE SIGNAL CHANGES.
story.chapters.description: The engine keeps working, but one parameter starts to change. In this simulation, oil temperature rises from 82 °C to 108 °C.
story.chapters.label: ENGINE → TEMPERATURE SIGNAL
story.chapters.name: THE DEVIATION APPEARS

story.chapters.title:
THE MACHINE
SPEAKS.
ACTISKY CONNECTS.
story.chapters.description: Through the signals available on the CAN network and the sensors, ActiSky connects the machine's condition to the platform. The reading gains identification, history and context.
story.chapters.label: CAN NETWORK → ACTISKY → PLATFORM
story.chapters.name: THE SIGNAL FINDS ITS PATH

story.chapters.title:
THE ALERT
REACHES
THE CAB.
story.chapters.description: On the industrial tablet, the operator sees which machine needs attention and which condition changed. Clear information to support the operation's procedure.
story.chapters.fact: DEMONSTRATION SCENE · CHANNELS CONFIGURED PER PROJECT.
story.chapters.label: ACTISKY → OPERATOR'S TABLET
story.chapters.name: THE INFORMATION ARRIVES

story.chapters.title:
THE TEAM
RECEIVES
THE SAME CONTEXT.
story.chapters.description: In the support pickup, the phone shows the same occurrence. Operation and maintenance can share the machine's context and coordinate the response.
story.chapters.label: TR-001 → FIELD TEAM
story.chapters.name: THE CONTEXT SPREADS

story.chapters.kicker: 09 / THE VIEW OF THE WHOLE OPERATION
story.chapters.title:
ONE FLEET.
ONE ALERT.
ONE DECISION.
story.chapters.description: In the control room, TR-001 stands out on the map. Position, signals and history help the team prioritize analysis and drive the operational decision.
story.chapters.fact: KEEP GOING TO EXPLORE THE COMBINATION OF SIGNALS.
story.chapters.label: FIELD → CONTROL ROOM
story.chapters.name: FROM MACHINE TO DECISION

lab.eyebrow: ONE SIGNAL IS A WARNING. THE COMBINATION IS CONTEXT.
lab.heading:
BEFORE THE STOP,
THE SIGNALS.
lab.intro: An engine doesn't tell its story in a single number. Temperature, pressure, load and history must be read together.
lab.label: TRY THE CORRELATION
lab.titleCompound:
Temperature and pressure
call for joint attention.
lab.descCompoundVib: Heated oil, reduced pressure and elevated vibration reinforce the occurrence. The team receives evidence to assess the machine's condition.
lab.descCompound: The combination of heated oil and reduced pressure meets the demonstration rule. The event gains context for the operation.
lab.descOne: A single parameter leaves the simulation range. The configured combination has not been met yet.
lab.descNone: Move the parameters or run the scenario to see when the signals combine and raise an alert.
lab.footnote: Values and ranges are illustrative only. The reading of pressure, temperature and vibration depends on the available signals and the sensors of each machine. Thresholds, persistence and hysteresis are configured for each application.
roadmap.liveText: AND/OR conditions, severity, temporal persistence and hysteresis to turn deviations into alerts with context. Activation depends on the machine and the project configuration.
roadmap.devText: Evolution from trend analysis to anomaly detection and predictive models. The goal is to recognize out-of-pattern combinations and support maintenance prioritization with evidence.
roadmap.devNote: The demonstration above uses illustrative rules; it does not represent inference from a trained AI model.
manifesto.title:
GIANT MACHINES.
PRECISE DECISIONS.
manifesto.text: Your mine is an ecosystem in motion. Minefy connects machines, people and data to turn what happens in the field into visibility for management.

fleet.stages.description: The operation starts before loading. Gather position, events and drill rig conditions to support field monitoring.

fleet.stages.title:
CONNECTION
ACROSS
THE MINE.
fleet.stages.description: The support fleet is also part of the whole. Track the movements and events of the pickups that connect field teams.

fleet.stages.title:
NEW
TERRAINS.
MORE VISION.
fleet.stages.description: Tailings management and water recovery in dams with Scroller. A Minefy services front that connects material handling to the operation's needs.
